name: Forsaken Rear Guard
summary: In the current era of Silverpine Forest, the bleak land north of the Sepulcher is known as the Dead Field. No fortified camp stands here; travelers find only the blighted, haunted earth of Lordaeron's fallen days.

sections.title: A Contested Expanse
sections.body: With no barracks or garrison of its own, this expanse north of the Sepulcher remains part of the Dead Field. The Forsaken maintain patrols along the road, but the ground itself is withered, haunted by remnants of the Third War and encroaching feral beasts.

faq.q: What is the Forsaken Rear Guard?
aliases: who is at the rear guard
faq.answer: No fortified Forsaken position stands here in Year 25. The land north of the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest is the blighted expanse known as the Dead Field.

faq.q: Where is this area located in Silverpine Forest?
faq.answer: It lies along the main road north of the Sepulcher, in northern Silverpine Forest where Forsaken scouts monitor wild predators and hostile forces.

faq.q: Why was this land called the Dead Field?
faq.answer: Like much of Silverpine Forest, the soil and vegetation withered during the Third War under the Scourge's corrupting plague, leaving behind lifeless fields populated by feral scavengers and wandering horrors.

angles.text: For the Forsaken, keeping the northern roads past the Sepulcher clear is crucial to maintaining supply lines and holding territory against hostile forces in northern Silverpine.
The central paths of Silverpine Forest are treacherous, and Horde travelers moving south toward the Greymane Wall must stay alert amid the blighted wilderness.
